objects.name: matter
objects.description: One client matter whose documents the chambers versions.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Finds a repository by the name a caller knows it as.

objects.name: negotiation
objects.description: One negotiating position on a matter, folded back in once agreed.

indexes.name: repository
indexes.description: Lists a repository's branches.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Finds a branch by name within a repository.

indexes.name: head
indexes.description: Finds the branch whose tip is a given commit.

indexes.name: run
indexes.description: Finds every branch one orchestrated run produced, for rollback.

objects.name: revision
objects.description: One recorded revision to a matter's documents.

indexes.name: repository
indexes.description: Lists a repository's commits.

indexes.name: sha
indexes.description: Finds a commit by hash, which is how every indexing path checks whether it already has one.

indexes.name: tree
indexes.description: Finds the commit that points at a given root tree.

objects.name: revision_parent
objects.description: Which revision a revision was made against.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Walks history backwards from a parent to its children.

objects.name: bundle
objects.description: The set of documents as they stood at one revision.

indexes.name: sha
indexes.description: Finds a tree by hash.

objects.name: bundle_document
objects.description: A document directly inside a bundle.

indexes.name: blob
indexes.description: Finds every directory a file is reachable from.

objects.name: bundle_section
objects.description: A bundle nested inside a bundle.

indexes.name: subtree
indexes.description: Finds every directory a subdirectory sits in.

objects.name: document
objects.description: One document's text as it stood at a revision.

indexes.name: sha
indexes.description: Finds a file by content hash.

indexes.name: path
indexes.description: Finds a file by the path it sits at.

objects.name: execution
objects.description: A named, frozen revision: the version that was signed.

indexes.name: repository
indexes.description: Lists a repository's tags.

indexes.name: commit
indexes.description: Finds the tags pointing at a commit.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Finds a tag by name.

objects.name: engrossment
objects.description: A request to fold one negotiating position into the agreed text.

indexes.name: repository
indexes.description: Lists a repository's merge requests.

indexes.name: source
indexes.description: Finds the request merging a given branch.

indexes.name: target
indexes.description: Lists the requests aimed at a given branch.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Lists the open requests without reading the closed ones.

indexes.name: run
indexes.description: Finds every request one orchestrated run opened, for rollback.

objects.name: clause_type
objects.description: A label the chambers files documents under, such as an indemnity or a warranty.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Lists a keyword's children.

indexes.name: scope
indexes.description: Lists the keywords in one grouping.

objects.name: document_clause
objects.description: Records that a document carries a clause type.

indexes.name: blob
indexes.description: Lists the keywords one file carries.

indexes.name: keyword
indexes.description: Finds every file carrying one keyword.

objects.name: document_link
objects.description: A named relationship between two documents, such as a schedule to its agreement.

indexes.name: from
indexes.description: Follows a file's outgoing relationships.

indexes.name: to
indexes.description: Follows a file's incoming relationships.

objects.name: intake_job
objects.description: The state of one intake of a matter's documents from outside.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Lists the imports still running.

objects.name: retrieval_job
objects.description: The state of one on-demand retrieval of a single negotiating position.

indexes.name: repository
indexes.description: Lists a repository's branch fetches.
